messages:
jasper: :rocket: Heads up — rolling out Hosted Stream Gateway GA now. This unifies streaming + tool-calling under a single endpoint (POST /v1/stream/gateway) and ships with the new mosaic-x-lite model (quantized, lower memory). Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga — please read before switching traffic.

michelle: Awesome! Quick q: will this be on by default for existing orgs?

jasper: New orgs get it enabled by default. Existing orgs have an opt-in toggle in Console for 2 weeks; after that we'll start automated migration windows (soft-migrate with canary routing first). Target auto-migration start: 2026-04-07.

michelle: Got it, thanks. Any special auth/keys needed?

jasper: No new auth scheme. Same API keys. If you want canary keys or higher-rate test access ping kevin. Example call:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/gateway 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model": "mosaic-x-lite", "stream": true, "tool_calls": true, "input": "..."}'
```

kevin: I can hand out canary keys — DM me. Also note there is an automatic fallback policy: if mosaic-x-lite latency spikes, requests will route to mosaic-pro-std as a warm fallback.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment report: stream-gateway service updated across 3 clusters, staged rollout 30% -> 100%, 0 failures. Logs: https://internal-logs/stream-gateway/1841200000

sarah: Jasper — tried the docs link, got a 404 on the migration section.

jasper: Thanks, fixed — correct migration anchor: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga/migrate. Updated the rollout checklist in Confluence as well.

michelle: I'll add a short note to the SDK changelog about defaulting the streaming client to the gateway endpoint.

jasper: TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA live, mosaic-x-lite available, opt-in for 2 weeks then auto-migrate, canary keys via kevin, fallback policies in place. Ping me or @kevin for any rollout issues. :tada:
